title: Workflow type definitions
description: Define TypeScript types for Workflow, WorkflowStep, WorkflowExecution, and supporting enums. Establish the data contract that all other tasks depend on.
action: Create src/types/workflow.ts with AgentMode, InputSource, CheckpointType enums, WorkflowStep, Workflow, WorkflowStepResult, WorkflowExecution interfaces, and builtin workflow template type. Export from src/types/index.ts barrel.

criteria: src/types/workflow.ts exists and exports AgentMode, InputSource, CheckpointType, WorkflowStep, Workflow, WorkflowStepResult, WorkflowExecution
src/types/index.ts contains re-export of workflow types
WorkflowStep has fields: id, name, agentMode, prompt, inputSource, checkpoint, enabled
Workflow has fields: id, name, description, steps[], isBuiltin, createdAt, updatedAt
WorkflowExecution has fields: id, workflowId, chapterId, status, currentStepIndex, stepResults[], startedAt, completedAt
convergence.verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no type errors in workflow.ts
convergence.definition_of_done: All workflow-related TypeScript types defined and exported, compilable without errors

files.change: New file with AgentMode, InputSource, CheckpointType union types, WorkflowStep, Workflow, WorkflowStepResult, WorkflowExecution interfaces

implementation: Define AgentMode = 'writing' | 'analysis' | 'evaluation' | 'custom' matching existing agent modes from src/api/agents.ts
Define CheckpointType = 'none' | 'review' | 'approve' for step checkpoint configuration
Define WorkflowStep interface: { id: string; name: string; agentMode: AgentMode; prompt: string; inputSource: InputSource; checkpoint: CheckpointType; enabled: boolean }
Define Workflow interface: { id: string; name: string; description: string; steps: WorkflowStep[]; isBuiltin: boolean; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string }
Define WorkflowStepResult interface: { stepIndex: number; input: string; output: string; status: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'skipped'; timestamp: string }

Define WorkflowExecution interface: { id: string; workflowId: string; chapterId: string; status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'failed'; currentStepIndex: number; stepResults: WorkflowStepResult[]; startedAt: string; completedAt: string | null }
